scope: All14 pregnancy-uti questions in UTI companion, including original stems/options/keys/rationales and replacement versions
reasonForChange: Generated questions used unrelated true statements as distractors, broad duration wording and mismatched pyelonephritis rationales. Replaced all14 with original clinical cases; preservedIDs and total130 questions.

questions.finding: Early culture screening is the sole correct option; symptom-only screening misses ASB.
Correctly attributes IDSA and ACOG duration ranges and drug-specific exception; no false conflict or universal one-day regimen.
Susceptibility is separated from patient safety and infected-site exposure; all options reviewed.
Single-dose exception is limited to the specific regimen; urine color is not a stopping criterion.
Lower-tract treatment retains culture, safety, general duration and fosfomycin exception.
Empiric aminopenicillin exclusion is attributed to resistance rather than absolute pregnancy prohibition.
Fever, flank pain and vomiting prompt upper-tract evaluation rather than continuation of bladder-only therapy.
Nonpregnant TMP-SMX duration is not automatically transferred to pregnancy; no new TMP-SMX pregnancy dose asserted.
Ability to swallow does not negate ACOG initial inpatient/parenteral pregnancy pyelonephritis care.
Fourteen days is total course, not fourteen additional IV days; automatic cUTI short-course import rejected.
Reassessment covers systemic and obstetric complications rather than dysuria or urine appearance alone.
39weeks is inside the label contraindication interval38–42weeks; susceptibility does not override fetal/neonatal safety.
Single3g fosfomycin regimen is not repeated to satisfy a general multi-day rule; symptoms prompt reassessment.
Urine susceptibility cannot overcome inadequate renal-tissue penetration; no blanket beta-lactam exclusion.

limitations: ACOG2024 correction body remains inaccessible; no unverified table doses imported.
This does not verify all130 companion questions or the complete module.

browser.checks: Stems, shuffled correct and incorrect answers, feedback/scoring, full rationale, review anchors and incomplete-submit behavior; no page errors or horizontal overflow
